VeraSafe is a U.S.-headquartered privacy and cybersecurity consulting firm and law firm, supporting organizations worldwide with data protection, compliance, and security matters.
We are a fully remote company and proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work®, with 97% of employees affirming a positive and supportive work environment. We value collaboration, high-quality work, and a balanced, sustainable approach to professional life.
Watch / listen to learn more about VeraSafe: Check out our podcast!
Apple Podcast : https://apple.co/4b28hwE
YouTube : https://www.youtube.com/@PrivacyInPractice/videos
Spotify: https://bit.ly/4moSMU7

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Project Coordinator to support the delivery of privacy and cybersecurity compliance projects.
This is a hands-on, execution-focused role. Success in this role depends on exceptional written communication, team coordination, disciplined task management and precise documentation, and the ability to manage multiple workstreams with accuracy and consistency. You will work closely with attorneys and IT security professionals to ensure projects run smoothly, efficiently, and in alignment with client expectations.
This role is well suited for individuals with project management experience. We are also open to individuals with experience in executive/administrative support who are looking to grow into a project management career within a legal consulting environment.
Note: We will ask you to participate in a short skills assessment as a first step in the selection/interview process.

Coordinate and execute project plans within defined scope, timelines, and budgets
Maintain accurate and up-to-date project records, tasks, and documentation
Schedule client and internal meetings, manage calendars carefully across time zones, and ensure key meetings and deadlines are set up accurately
Attend client and internal meetings; produce accurate, complete, and well-structured meeting minutes with clear action items, owners, and deadlines
Monitor project progress, prioritize gating tasks, proactively flag risks or blockers, and provide timely updates and recommended next steps
Communicate regularly with attorneys, team members, and clients regarding status and next steps
Ensure adherence to internal processes, standards, and best practices
Support workload coordination across team members
Assist in documenting and improving business processes

Exceptional attention to detail and organizational ability
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously
Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset
Team player
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, fully remote environment
Proficiency with productivity and project management tools (e.g., Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Asana, Jira, Teamwork)

4+ years of experience in project coordination or project management
Experience taking detailed meeting minutes and managing action items
Experience in professional services, consulting, legal, or technology environments preferred
Exposure to IT, cybersecurity, or compliance-related projects is a strong plus

Project management certifications (e.g., CAPM, PRINCE2 Foundation)
Exposure to Agile methodologies
Background in legal, IT audit, or cybersecurity disciplines is a plus

Work from almost anywhere with Wi-Fi
Paid Time Off (PTO)
Paid holidays
Annual bonuses
Membership in the International Association of Privacy Professionals (IAPP) and IAPP exam fee reimbursement (CIPP/E)
Flexible working schedule in some roles
Reimbursement for certain personal flight ticket
Company laptop provided

Tremendous professional development growth opportunities in the privacy, data protection, and cybersecurity niche
The chance to have a long-lasting effect on a small but growing international business
Work in an open environment with a team that respects your ideas and contributions
Occasional opportunities to travel in North America and Europe
Our HR Privacy Notice is available at the following link: https://verasafe.com/legal/human-resources-privacy-policy/

The GS-15 salary range starts at $150,359 per year. To qualify, you must have at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-14 level or higher in the Federal service. Specialized experience is overseeing teams responsible for the management of projects to deliver strategic national programs or initiatives.

This experience must include: Planning, directing and advising others in applying project management policies and procedures to achieve organizational and programmatic goals, Advising diverse organizational representatives on issues involving the application or tailoring of program management methods and procedures, and Working on complex national programs or cross-agency strategic initiatives with multidisciplinary teams, and in two or more of the following program areas: Client/Stakeholder Relationships; Cost and Schedule Management Analysis for Programs; Program Management and Team Leadership; or Construction Management

Serves within Defense Logistics Agency (DLA), Information Operations J62 Program Executive Office (PEO), J62X System Applications and Products (SAP) Platform, specifically in Warehouse Management System (WMS) Portfolio (J62XD).
Serves as the Equipment Control Systems (ECS), SAP Material Flow Systems (MFS) and all automation IT Project Manager for WMS Portfolio delivering and sustaining WMS (Extended Warehouse Management (EWM)...
... Transportation Management (TM), ERP Central Component (ECC), S/4HANA, Fiori, etc) across the DLA Major Subordinate Commands (MSCs) (Distribution, Disposition Services, etc).
Provides project management oversight for the integration and deployment of Enterprise business capabilities utilizing Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) and Government Off-The-Shelf (GOTS) packages...
... such as WMS, ECS, Warehouse Control Systems (WCS), Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC), MFS, and physical warehouse automation solutions.
Oversees control configurations for conveyor systems, Automated Storage and Retrieval Systems (AS/RS), scanners, and sensors to coordinate real-time physical movements of handling units (HUs).
Leads the integration and deployment of SAP AutoStore within SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM).
Manages projects to implement cube-based automated storage system, coordinating the alignment of robotic physical movements, grid configurations...
...., and workstation (port) interfaces to support high-efficiency "goods-to-person" picking and replenishment.
Leads and manages the development and execution of comprehensive IT project plans, integrated schedules, risk mitigations, and knowledge transfer artifacts for all automation and hardware-integration initiatives.
Maintains critical communications and situational awareness of automation project scopes, resource requirements, and milestone statuses with all stakeholders, including team members, senior leadership, and DLA customer networks.
Facilitates direct collaboration between DLA warehouse operators, technical subject matter experts, and hardware vendors to align physical automation requirements with core software capabilities.
Monitors, tracks, and manages project milestones and system integration defects utilizing the Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) tool.
Evaluates project progress, system effectiveness, and delivery quality, developing targeted tools and methods to track automation life-cycle milestones.
Coordinates the integration of automation workflows with inbound, outbound, and internal logistics processes across DLA Distribution, Disposition Services, and military services within SAP S/4, ECC, EWM, TM, and Fiori.
Represents the agency at meetings and conferences involving senior level personnel throughout Department of War (DoW), other government agencies and private industry.
Provides support in achieving DLA audit readiness goals and objectives to include direct support to audit readiness teams through the completion of specific tasks and deliverables.
To qualify for an IT Project Manager (SYSANALYSIS) your resume and supporting documentation must support: A. Specialized Experience: One year of specialized experience that equipped you with the particular competencies to successfully perform the duties of the position, and is directly in or related to this position.

To qualify at the GS-13 level, applicants must possess one year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-12 level or equivalent under other pay systems in the Federal service, military or private sector.

Applicants must meet eligibility requirements including time-in-grade (General Schedule (GS) positions only), time-after-competitive appointment, minimum qualifications, and any other regulatory requirements by the cut-off/closing date of the announcement.

Creditable specialized experience includes: - Provides specific expertise in the areas of IT Project Management, policies, principals, methods and practices to define project resources, milestones and deliverables; develop IT System interoperability test plans and schedules for the modernization of warehouse automation, including transitioning from legacy Equipment Control Systems (ECS) to SAP Material Flow Systems (MFS) and modern hardware integrations. - Leads and executes interoperability IT testing strategy concurrently spanning multi-disciplined project teams to integrate enterprise software (SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM)) with physical warehouse automation hardware, such as Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), Automated Storage and Retrieval Systems (AS/RS), and cube-based robotic storage (AutoStore). - Supports analysis of data and comparable activities in support of goals and objectives related to high levels of program and project management as supported by the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and hardware integration lifecycles, ensuring continuous, real-time routing, capacity monitoring, and malfunction reporting for automated systems. - Assures industry standard project management methodology is implemented for maximum effectiveness, efficiency and success of assigned IT projects, driving seamless interoperability between SAP environments and modern automation tools, sensors, and scanners while safely phasing out legacy control infrastructure.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Applications will be referred based on receipt of application and established cutoff dates as follows: 1st cutoff date: 07/17/2026 Last cutoff date: 07/24/2026 We encourage you to read this entire vacancy announcement prior to submitting your application. This position is eligible for Remote/Virtual work.

However, this position may fall under the Presidential Memorandum titled "Return to In-Person Work" which will require you to go into the office if you are located within 50 miles of a Department of Education facility in these locations: Washington, DC, Dallas, TX, San Francisco, CA, Seattle, WA, Kansas City, MO, Chicago, Il, Atlanta, GA, Philadelphia, PA, New York City, NY, and location is negotiable.

Actual salary will be based on location of selectee. Locality pay tables available at www.opm.gov . As a IT Project Manager, GS-2210-14, you will be responsible for:
· Managing and ensuring the performance of role-specific tasks: project, time, resource, and budget management, scope management, schedule management, risk management and coordination on contracts and contracts management and oversight.
· Managing the identification and coordination of technical activities of project team(s), prioritizes and facilitates technical tasks and sequence tracks of work, of IT projects/initiatives in an iterative, incremental, parallel, and time-boxed manner aligned to deliver business value.
· Managing and ensures the performance of role-specific tasks: project, time, resource, and budget management, scope management, schedule management, risk management and coordination on contracts and contracts management and oversight (in role as Contracting Officer's Technical Representative [COTR]/ Contracting Office Representative [COR]).
· Identifying and consulting on technical resource requirements for projects (e.g., analysts, developers, quality assurance), and onboard qualified resources to support project needs.
· Managing effectively and efficiently various Information Technology (IT) projects.
Minimum Qualification Requirements You may meet the minimum qualifications for the GS-14, if you possess the specialized experience.

Specialized Experience for the GS-14 One year of experience in either federal or non-federal service that is equivalent to at least a GS-13 performing two (2) out of three (3) of the following duties or work assignments: 1.

Experience leading cross-functional project teams utilizing agile methodologies and practices while identifying and managing associated risks, issues, contracts, and change requests to meet schedule, budget, and organizational policies and objectives to facilitate the delivery of incremental software or system enhancements. 2.

Experience in applying agile methods to support technical integration, system modernization, and continuous improvement initiatives to ensure IT systems are compatible with architecture, cloud platforms, system interfaces, and cybersecurity requirements to reduce technical debt and improve release predictability. 3.

Experience implementing risk and issue management processes, ensuring potential blockers are identified early, escalated appropriately, resolved and aligned with established change-control processes within agile release frameworks to adhere to program timelines and deliverables.

Basic Experience Requirements You must possess IT related experience (paid or unpaid experience and/or completion of specific, intensive training (e.g., IT certification), as appropriate) demonstrating each of the nine competencies listed below. 1. Attention to Detail - Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail. 2.

Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services. 3.

Decision Making - Makes sound, well-informed, and objective decisions; perceives the impact and implications of decisions; commits to action, even in uncertain situations, to accomplish organizational goals; causes change. 4.

Information Management - Identifies a need for and knows where or how to gather information; organizes and maintains information or information management systems. 5.

Interpersonal Skills - Shows understanding, friendliness, courtesy, tact, empathy, concern, and politeness to others; develops and maintains effective relationships with others; may include effectively dealing with individuals who are difficult, hostile, or distressed; relates well to people from varied backgrounds and different situations 6.

Oral Communication - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately. 7.

Problem Solving - Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations. 8. Teamwork - Encourages and facilitates cooperation, pride, trust, and group identity; fosters commitment and team spirit; works with others to achieve goals. 9.

Technical Competence – Uses knowledge that is acquired through formal training or on-the-job experience to perform one's job; works with, understands, and evaluates technical information related to the job; advises others on technical issues.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSAs) The quality of your experience will be measured by the extent to which you possess the following knowledge, skills and abilities (KSAs).

You do not need to provide separate narrative responses to these KSAs, as they will be measured by your responses to the occupational questionnaire (you may preview the occupational questionnaire by clicking the link at the end of the Evaluations section of this vacancy announcement). 1.

Skill in leading and directing people, teams and programs / projects associated with IT application development; the development of mission-critical enterprise class applications, and enterprise-wide IT projects 2.

Ability to deliver mission critical IT initiatives to meet organizational objectives using agile project management tools or techniques. 3. Ability to develop acquisition artifacts required to procure, and provide services for implementation, and operations and maintenance of an IT system and oversee vendor performance upon contract award. 4.

Ability to lead complex IT initiatives while managing changing priorities, evolving legislative or regulatory requirements and coordinating with various internal and external stakeholders.

Typical work assignments at the GS-13 level include, but are not limited to: Assessing policy needs and collaborate with stakeholders to develop policies to govern cyber activities. Monitoring and providing analysis on gathered feedback on customer satisfaction and internal service performance to foster continual improvement.

Assisting/Conducting audits of information technology (IT) programs and projects. Developing, maintaining, and communicating program-to support consistent execution and informed decision-making.

Building and sustaining productive relationships with customers, IT process owners, service managers, product owners, procurement officials, and interagency stakeholders to coordinate requirements, service delivery, and policy outcomes. Establishing and maintaining communication channels with stakeholders.

Identifying service delivery gaps, security control weaknesses, and procurement-related risks. Typical work assignments at the GS-14 level include, but are not limited to: Balancing and prioritizing services to meet overall customer requirements, constraints, and objectives.

Evaluating trade-offs among cost, schedule, performance, and security to recommend project costs, design concepts, and design changes across the acquisition life cycle. Developing, maintaining, and communicating program-to support consistent execution and informed decision-making.

Managing the internal relationship with information technology (IT) process owners supporting the service, assisting with the definition and agreement of Operating Level Agreements. Briefing leadership on significant service performance issues, tailoring messages to the audience and decision needed.

Developing recommendations for optimization, upgrades, and corrective actions; and track issues to resolution. Collaborating with stakeholders to develop policies to govern cyber activities. Providing guidance across the total acquisition life cycle (including National Security Systems where applicable).
Do NOT copy and paste the duties, specialized experience, or occupational assessment questionnaire from this announcement into your resume as that will not be considered a demonstration of your qualifications for this position. Your resume must describe your work and experience, in your own words.

To be considered minimally qualified for this position, you must demonstrate that you have the required proficiency level of competencies and experience for the respective grade level in which you are applying.

REQUIRED COMPETENCIES: Experience must be Information Technology (IT)-related; the experience may be demonstrated by paid or unpaid experience and/or completion of specific, intensive training (for example, IT certification), as appropriate.

You must have IT-related experience demonstrating each of the required competencies listed below and must meet or exceed the minimum proficiency level established for each by grade level. For more information, see Competency-Based Qualification Standard for the Information Technology Management Series, 2210.

You qualify at the GS-13 and GS-14 grade level, if you have: Attention to Detail - Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.

Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services.

Decision Making - Makes sound, well-informed, and objective decisions; perceives the impact and implications of decisions; commits to action, even in uncertain situations, to accomplish organizational goals; causes change.

Information Management - Identifies a need for and knows where or how to gather information; organizes and maintains information or information management systems.

Interpersonal Skills - Shows understanding, friendliness, courtesy, tact, empathy, concern, and politeness to others; develops and maintains effective relationships with others; may include effectively dealing with individuals who are difficult, hostile, or distressed; relates well to people from varied backgrounds and different situations.

Oral Communication - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.

Problem Solving - Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations. Teamwork - Encourages and facilitates cooperation, pride, trust, and group identity; fosters commitment and team spirit; works with others to achieve goals.

Technical Competence - Uses knowledge that is acquired through formal training or on-the-job experience to perform one's job; works with, understands, and evaluates technical information related to the job; advises others on technical issues.

AND SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE: In addition to meeting the qualification requirement listed above, you must have at least one year of specialized experience at the next lower GS-grade level (or equivalent).

Specialized experience is experience that has equipped you with the particular competencies/knowledge, skills, and abilities to successfully perform the duties of the position and is typically in or related to the work of the position to be filled.

Such experience is typically gained in the IT field or through the performance of work where the primary concern is IT.

You qualify at the GS-13 grade level, if you have: EXPERIENCE: At least one (1) year of specialized experience at the GS-12 grade level (or equivalent) performing at least four (4) of the following duties: Defining technical related programs and projects; Developing technical plans, strategy and policies to support and align with organizational cybersecurity initiatives and regulatory compliance; Developing methods to monitor and measure risk, compliance, and assurance efforts; Managing the underlying technical operational processes; Advocating for changes in policy that will support new initiatives or required changes/enhancements; Consulting with customers to evaluate functional requirements and translate functional requirements into technical solutions; Overseeing the development, implementation and evaluation of solutions for cybersecurity tools integration based on systems requirements, capabilities, and constraints to ensure the design meets customers' satisfaction; OR Managing the technical planning process to ensure that developed solutions meet customer requirements.

You qualify at the GS-14 grade level, if you have: EXPERIENCE: At least one (1) year of specialized experience at the GS-13 grade level (or equivalent) performing at least four (4) of the following duties: Leading development of methods to monitor and measure risk, compliance, and assurance efforts; Reviewing needs analysis to determine opportunities for new and improved business process solutions are relevant to the organization; Reviewing technical data to ensure they meet customer requirements; Administering policy guidance to technical management, staff and users; Recommending the appropriate measures through internal and/or external product releases (alerts, advisories, etc.); Conducting risk and vulnerability assessments to protect infrastructure assets and mitigate network vulnerabilities; Providing advisory services to leadership to ensure the proper operation of technical systems throughout an organization; Providing technical expertise of current and evolving best practices in cybersecurity and to the broader stakeholder community; OR Leading partnership meetings with external stakeholders.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Time-in-Grade Requirements: Under competitive merit promotion procedures, any individual who is currently holding, or who has held within the previous 52 weeks, a General Schedule (GS) position under a non-temporary appointment in the competitive or excepted service, must meet "time-in-grade" requirements (have served 52 weeks at the next lower grade of the grade for which you are applying).

Time After Competitive Appointment: By the closing date specified in this job announcement, current Federal civilian employees must wait at least 90 days after their latest non-temporary appointment from a competitive service referral certificate before promotion, transfer, reinstatement, reassignment, or detail.

All qualification requirements, including Time-in-Grade, must be met by the closing date of this announcement. Qualification AND Time-in-Grade claims will be subject to verification.

DO-1101-02 Interacts with many different internal and external personnel and organizations. Recommends acquisition strategies and approaches. Identifies and implements improved approaches to deliver capability. Advises and supports in the definition of requirements and budgets. Implements acquisition plans.

Accurately determines program goals and objectives. Assesses and manages acquisition program risks. Proactively identifies cost, schedule, technical and/or programmatic risks. Reports schedule risks early and develops get well plans to ensure budget execution and mission accomplishment needs are met.

Develops and implements effective risk mitigation plans. Leads source selection activities and coordinates technical evaluation efforts with project leads. Prepares a variety of documents to include requirement statements, cost estimates, market research reports, justification & approvals, acquisition plans and other related acquisition documents.

Meets due dates for procurement packages. Holds contractor accountable to meet requirements identified in their contract. Consistently applies sound principles, concepts and work processes to problems and concerns routinely keeping higher management levels informed. Adheres to security policies/directives/SOPs.
Experience requirements are described in the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) Qualification Standards for General Schedule Positions, Group Coverage Qualification Standard for Administrative and Management Positions.

Due to the use of 120-day rosters, this period of experience may be completed within 120 days of the closing date of this announcement.

In addition to meeting the basic requirement above, to qualify for this position you must also meet the qualification requirements listed below: SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE: Applicants must have at least one year (52 weeks) of specialized experience at the next lower grade DR-01 / GS-11, or equivalent in other pay systems.

Examples of specialized experience includes applying concepts, principles, procedures, regulations, laws, and/or instructions applicable to pre and post award of contracts, leading source selection activities that included the technical evaluation of contractor proposals, and/or implementing acquisition strategies.

NOTE: Due to the use of 120-day rosters, this period of experience may be completed within 120 days of the closing date of this announcement.

COMPETENCIES: Your qualifications will be evaluated on the basis of your level of knowledge, skills, abilities and/or competencies in the following areas: Problem Solving, Communication, Business Management, Teamwork and Leadership IDEAL CANDIDATE: In addition to the specialized experience statements above, the ideal candidate would have the following skills and experience: Ideal candidate is a proactive and seasoned acquisition professional who thrives in a high-stakes, mission-driven environment.

They are not just an acquisition program manager; they are a strategic thinker and a leader who understands that their work directly contributes to national security. This individual is adept at navigating the complexities of the DoD acquisition landscape and is driven by the challenge of delivering cutting-edge capabilities to the warfighter.

Program manager- Candidate has a deep and practical understanding of the entire acquisition lifecycle, from the initial spark of a requirement to the final delivery and sustainment. They can speak with authority on everything from Simplified Acquisition Procedures and IDIQs to the nuances of R&D funding.

They don't just know the regulations; they understand the strategy behind them Leadership- While the position is non-supervisory, our ideal candidate is a recognized leader. They have a proven ability to lead Integrated Product Teams (IPTs), uniting scientists, analysts, and contracting officers toward a common goal.

They build bridges, foster open communication, and are respected for their ability to listen and integrate diverse perspectives.

Their colleagues see them as a reliable and indispensable partner Problem Solving- When faced with a roadblock-be it a funding shortfall, a technical challenge, or a schedule slip-this individual doesn't just report the problem; they come to the table with solutions.

They are skilled at risk analysis and mitigation, always looking ahead to anticipate challenges and develop contingency plans. They have the business acumen to evaluate contractor proposals with a critical eye and the confidence to hold them accountable Strategic Thinking- Candidate understands the gravity of JWAC's mission.

They are cleared for the nation's most sensitive information and carry that responsibility with the utmost integrity. They are resilient, adaptable, and comfortable with the unique pressures of working in a classified environment. PART-TIME OR UNPAID EXPERIENCE: Credit will be given for appropriate unpaid and or part-time work.

You must clearly identify the duties and responsibilities in each position held and the total number of hours per week.

VOLUNTEER WORK EXPERIENCE: Refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service Programs (i.e., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community; student and social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge and skills that can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

The initial application review cut-off for this job announcement is 50 applications. The first 50 applications received will be considered first. Applications received after the initial cut-off number (50 applications) may not receive consideration unless otherwise requested by management.

If management requests additional certificates, applicants will continue to be reviewed in groups of 50 in the order they applied. Note: Submitting multiple applications will change the order in which your application is reviewed.

Major Duties: Initiates and manages IT projects as well as special technical studies related to executing the EHRM-IO mission.

Projects cover a wide area of scope within EHRM workstreams including but not limited to deployments, new/enhanced solutions and capabilities/integrations, transition to sustainment projects, technical operations, domain operations, infrastructure.

Coordinates and/or conducts presentations in long range and annual work planning and IT capabilities to advise on the proposed formulation, management and execution of program resources (personnel and funding) and other management matters through an understanding of requirements and policies based on capabilities and resources.

Evaluates, monitors, or ensures compliance with Federal, VA laws and regulations, policies, standards, or procedures; Identifies standards or requirements for infrastructure, technical configuration or technical change management, Section 508 Accessibility compliance.

Promotion Potential: The selectee may be promoted to the full performance level without further competition when all regulatory, qualification, and performance requirements are met. Selection at a lower grade level does not guarantee promotion to the full performance level.

Work Schedule: Monday-Friday 8:00 am - 4:30 pm Compressed/Flexible: Yes Telework: This position may be authorized for telework. Telework eligibility will be discussed during the interview process. Virtual: This is not a virtual position. Position Description Title/PD#: It Project Manager/PD20983A Physical Requirements: The work is sedentary.

Some work will require walking and standing in conjunction with travel and attendance at meetings and conferences away from the work site. Some employees may carry light items, such as papers, books, or small parts. The work does not require any special physical effort. Work may require occasional travel.
To qualify for this position, applicants must meet all requirements by the closing date of this announcement, 08/25/2026. Applicants must meet the requirements of the competency-based qualification standard to be fully qualified. NOTE: The basic requirements MUST be substantiated in your resume.

Failure to provide the required information will render your application ineligible for consideration. For all positions, individuals must meet or exceed the minimum proficiency level established for each of the nine competencies listed below.

The employing agency is responsible for identifying the specific level of proficiency required for each competency at each grade level based on the requirements of the position being filled.

Delivery Manager – Biomechanics
Join Our Team at Sony Sports Technology
Value Stream: Biomechanics
Location: Hybrid working – minimum 2 days per week in the office
Office locations: Basingstoke, London or Bristol
Contract: Permanent, Full-Time

Hi, we're Amy Ogren and Robert Hulbert, and we're looking for a Delivery Manager to join our growing Biomechanics Value Stream. This is an exciting opportunity to join one of the fastest-growing areas within Sony Sports Technology. Our team combines Hawk-Eye's world-leading tracking technology with KinaTrax's markerless motion capture systems to provide cutting-edge athlete performance insights across elite sport.
You'll be joining a collaborative team of around 20 people that's expected to grow to approximately 25 over the coming year. Unlike many delivery roles that focus on a single product or sport, you'll support initiatives across Major League Baseball, the NFL, NBA, NHL, cricket, tennis and golf.
You'll also be joining at an exciting time as we continue delivering one of Sony Sports Technology's largest strategic partnerships while helping shape the future of biomechanics technology.

We're looking for someone who enjoys bringing people together, solving problems and helping technical teams deliver their best work.
As a Delivery Manager, you'll work closely with Product Managers, Engineering Leads, Solution Owners and software engineers to coordinate the delivery of technical initiatives across our biomechanics products.
You'll help keep projects moving by managing priorities, coordinating dependencies, identifying risks early and ensuring teams have the information they need to deliver successfully.
This isn't a traditional project management role. Priorities can change quickly as new opportunities emerge across multiple sports, so we're looking for someone who enjoys working in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where no two weeks are quite the same.
What You'll Work On
Supporting delivery across multiple biomechanics products and sports initiatives.
Coordinating work across engineering, product and operational teams.
Managing delivery roadmaps, milestones and project planning activities.
Supporting Agile ceremonies, sprint planning and delivery processes.
Tracking project progress and ensuring stakeholders have clear visibility of delivery.
Identifying risks, dependencies and blockers before they impact delivery.
Working closely with Product Managers, Engineering Leads and Solution Owners to coordinate priorities.
Helping improve delivery processes and ways of working across the Biomechanics Value Stream.
Building strong relationships with technical and business stakeholders across Sony Sports Technology.
What Success Looks Like
Your first few months will focus on learning the products, understanding how our teams work and building strong relationships across the business.

* Driven, passionate, ambitious

## Rejoignez un environnement industriel innovant ##
Chez BOBST, nous concevons et développons des solutions de pointe pour l-industrie de l-emballage. Sur notre campus, le Facility Management joue un rôle clé dans la transformation de nos infrastructures et le soutien de nos activités industrielles.
Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons un(e) PMO / Chef de projet Facility Management pour piloter des projets variés et stratégiques.
## Votre mission ##
Vous contribuez à la transformation et à la performance de notre campus en pilotant un portefeuille de projets et en assurant leur exécution de bout en bout.

* des projets de rénovation, transformation et construction
* l-aménagement d-espaces de production et de bureaux
* des initiatives énergétiques et de décarbonation
* la digitalisation des outils Facility Management (CAFM, GMAO, reporting)
## Vos responsabilités ##
### PMO - Pilotage global ###
* Développer une vision consolidée du portefeuille de projets
* Élaborer et suivre les budgets d-investissement
* Prioriser les projets et coordonner les ressources
* Mettre en place et suivre les indicateurs de performance
* Anticiper et gérer les risques
* Assurer un reporting régulier à la direction
### Gestion de projets ###
* Piloter les projets sur l-ensemble des phases SIA
* Analyser les besoins et définir les solutions techniques
* Planifier, budgétiser et suivre les coûts, délais et qualité
* Gérer les appels d-offres et coordonner les partenaires
* Superviser l-exécution des travaux
* Assurer la réception et la mise en service des installations
## Votre profil ##
### Formation ###
* Ingénieur en techniques du bâtiment, énergie ou formation équivalente
* Une certification en gestion de projet constitue un atout
### Expérience ###
* Minimum 5 ans d-expérience dans la gestion de projets immobiliers
* Expérience confirmée sur les différentes phases SIA
* Expérience en environnement industriel ou projets complexes souhaitée
### Compétences techniques ###
* Solides connaissances en techniques du bâtiment (CVCS, électricité)
* Bonne compréhension des interfaces architecturales
* Maîtrise des outils AutoCAD et MS Project (Revit est un plus)
* Connaissances des normes suisses (SIA, AEAI, MINERGIE)
### Qualités personnelles ###
* Rigueur et sens de l-organisation
* Capacité à gérer plusieurs projets simultanément
* Esprit d-analyse et orientation solutions
* Aisance relationnelle et collaboration avec des parties prenantes variées

Unser Auftraggeber versorgt die Region Fribourg - Bern mit nachhaltigen Baustoffen aus der Region. Diese bestehen zur Hälfte aus Kiesgruben und zur Hälfte aus recycelten Materialien. Mit modernster Technologie stellt das Unternehmen Kies, Beton und Recyclingprodukte her, transportiert diese umweltbewusst und garantiert zertifizierte Qualität.

Durch konsequentes Recycling trägt das Unternehmen zur Schonung natürlicher Ressourcen und zur Wiederverwertung von Bauabfällen bei. * Sie werden in einem dynamischen Umfeld arbeiten, in dem Teamarbeit und Kommunikation von großer Bedeutung sind.
* Ihre Fähigkeit, technische Informationen verständlich zu vermitteln, wird Ihnen helfen, das Vertrauen der Kunden zu gewinnen und langfristige Beziehungen aufzubauen.

Du hast bereits in einer Agentur gearbeitet , behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Kundenprojekten den Überblick und fühlst dich zwischen Kundenmeeting, Contentproduktion und Projektplanung wohl?
Dann suchen wir dich als Projektmanager (m/w/d) für unser Team bei wirdenkenlokal .
Wir sind Medienhaus und Agentur mit Sitz in Nürnberg und unterstützen Unternehmen dabei, sichtbar zu werden , neue Kunden zu erreichen und passende Mitarbeitende zu gewinnen . Dafür entwickeln und realisieren wir Projekte rund um Social Media, Video- und Fotoproduktion, Onlinekampagnen, PR und Events .
Für die Steuerung unserer Kundenprojekte suchen wir jemanden, der Verantwortung übernimmt , strukturiert arbeitet und gleichzeitig versteht, dass Agenturalltag nicht immer nach Lehrbuch läuft.
Aufgaben
Projektmanagement: Du übernimmst die eigenständige Steuerung unserer Agenturprojekte – von der Planung über die Koordination der Umsetzung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Dabei betreust du Social-Media-Projekte, Videoproduktionen, Fotoshootings und weitere Online-Marketing-Kampagnen.
Kundenbetreuung & Beratung: Du bist eine zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden, führst regelmäßige Kundentermine und berätst sie entlang unseres Leistungsportfolios. Du verstehst, was der Kunde erreichen möchte, übersetzt Anforderungen in konkrete Aufgaben und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Team passende Lösungen.
Koordination & Überblick: Mehrere Kunden, unterschiedliche Deadlines und verschiedene interne Ansprechpartner gleichzeitig? Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel. Du priorisierst Aufgaben, koordinierst Timings und Ressourcen und sorgst dafür, dass alle Beteiligten wissen, was wann zu tun ist.
Contentproduktionen: Du bist nicht nur am Schreibtisch: Bei ausgewählten Video- und Fotoproduktionen unterstützt du unser Team vor Ort, koordinierst Abläufe und stellst gemeinsam mit unseren Kreativen sicher, dass die Anforderungen des Kunden umgesetzt werden.
Schnittstelle zwischen Kunde und Team: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Social-Media-Managern, Videografen, Fotografen und weiteren Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen. Informationen, Feedback und Freigaben laufen bei dir zusammen und werden von dir strukturiert weitergegeben.
Projektmanagement mit Awork: Wir organisieren unsere Projekte mit Awork. Du musst das Tool noch nicht kennen – Erfahrung mit Projektmanagement-Tools wie Awork, Asana, Monday, Trello oder vergleichbaren Lösungen setzen wir allerdings voraus.
KI & Prozessoptimierung: Wir nutzen KI bereits intensiv in unserem Arbeitsalltag und wollen das weiter ausbauen. Du bist offen dafür, KI-Tools sowohl innerhalb von Kundenprojekten als auch zur Optimierung unserer internen Prozesse einzusetzen, neue Möglichkeiten auszuprobieren und bestehende Abläufe kontinuierlich besser zu machen.
Qualifikation
Agenturerfahrung: Du hast bereits in einer Marketing-, Social-Media-, Digital-, Content- oder vergleichbaren Agentur gearbeitet und kennst die Dynamik des Agenturalltags.
Erfahrung im Online-Marketing: Du bringst praktische Vorerfahrung und ein gutes Verständnis für Social Media, Contentproduktion und Onlinekampagnen mit. Du musst nicht alles selbst umsetzen können – aber du solltest verstehen, wie gute Projekte in diesen Bereichen geplant und realisiert werden.
Organisationstalent: Du kannst mehrere Kundenprojekte gleichzeitig steuern, Prioritäten setzen und verlierst auch dann nicht den Überblick, wenn an einem Tag fünf Dinge gleichzeitig passieren.
Stressresistenz: Wenn es turbulent wird, wirst du nicht hektisch, sondern fokussiert. Du kannst mit Zeitdruck, kurzfristigen Änderungen und intensiveren Projektphasen umgehen und läufst dann eher zur Höchstform auf, als den Überblick zu verlieren.
Kommunikationsstärke: Eine klare, professionelle und zielführende Kommunikation – schriftlich wie mündlich – setzen wir voraus. Du kannst sowohl souverän mit Kunden kommunizieren als auch intern klare Briefings und Aufgaben formulieren.
Eigenverantwortung: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand jeden nächsten Schritt vorgibt. Du erkennst, was zu tun ist, sprichst Probleme frühzeitig an und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Projekte.
Interesse an Marketing & Medien: Social Media, Marketing, Medien und digitale Kommunikation interessieren dich auch über deine unmittelbaren Aufgaben hinaus. Du willst verstehen, welche Plattformen, Formate und Entwicklungen gerade relevant sind.
Offenheit für KI: ChatGPT, Claude und andere KI-Tools sind für dich keine Bedrohung, sondern Werkzeuge. Du hast Lust darauf, herauszufinden, wie wir damit bessere Ergebnisse erzielen und effizienter arbeiten können.

Abwechslung statt immer gleicher Projekte: Vom regionalen Mittelständler bis zum Konzern, von Social-Media-Betreuung über Recruitingkampagnen bis zur Videoproduktion: Du arbeitest mit Kunden aus unterschiedlichsten Branchen und an sehr unterschiedlichen Projekten.
Du siehst, was deine Arbeit bewirkt: Unsere Projekte sollen nicht einfach nur gut aussehen. Wir helfen Unternehmen dabei, sichtbarer zu werden, neue Kunden zu erreichen und passende Mitarbeitende zu gewinnen – insbesondere Unternehmen aus unserer Region.
Ein Arbeitsplatz mit Aussicht: Unser Büro befindet sich im Business Tower Nürnberg – in einem der höchsten Büros der Region.
Kurze Wege & flache Hierarchien: Du arbeitest in einem Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem nahbaren Führungsteam. Gute Ideen müssen bei uns nicht erst durch fünf Hierarchieebenen.
Moderne Arbeitsweise: Wir arbeiten digital, nutzen moderne Projektmanagement- und KI-Tools und entwickeln unsere internen Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter.
Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten gehören für uns genauso dazu wie die notwendige Flexibilität, die ein abwechslungsreicher Agenturalltag manchmal mit sich bringt.
Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Wir wachsen als Unternehmen weiter – und damit entstehen auch für dich Möglichkeiten, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Serve as primary contact for the Sponsor

Lead client calls effectively

PMP or PRINCE2 certification is an asset

Vorweg, damit wir uns die Zeit sparen: Wir suchen keine Person, die Tickets von links nach rechts schiebt. Wir suchen jemanden, der einem Kunden auch mal widerspricht – mit guten Argumenten und Zahlen im Rücken.
Wenn du beim Wort „Freigabeprozess" innerlich aufatmest, wird das hier nichts. Wenn du beim Wort „Business Value" schon eine Rückfrage im Kopf hast: lies weiter.
Wer wir sind
creativestyle ist eine E-Commerce-Agentur mit deutsch-polnischem Setup: Projektmanagement in München, Entwicklung in Krakau und Rybnik. Über 120 umgesetzte Shops, rund 110 Leute, Kunden wie benuta, NKD, BRAX, CEWE Fotobuch, Einhell, Rieker und Bergzeit.
Dieses Jahr haben wir richtig abgeräumt: Agentur des Jahres, dazu zwei Auszeichnungen gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden – Best Customer Experience mit benuta, Best Mobile Experience mit Bergzeit.

Jede und jeder bei uns hat einen technischen Background. Die Geschäftsführung eingeschlossen.
50% Freiheit, 50% Verantwortung. Beides gilt gleichzeitig.
Fehler sind bei uns Lektionen, keine Schuldfrage. Wir steigen nur ungern zweimal in denselben Fluss.
Corporate sind wir nicht. Unzuverlässig allerdings auch nicht – und falls du glaubst, dass sich das ausschließt, beweisen wir dir gern das Gegenteil.
Wir nehmen keine Projekte an, auf die wir keine Lust haben. Aufgeräumt wird hier nur, was wir selbst angefangen haben.
Warum wir diese Stelle gerade jetzt besetzen

1. Wir bauen unser PIM- und ERP-Geschäft aus. Ab nächstem Jahr bieten wir Pimcore und Odoo an. Wir suchen jemanden, der diese Projekte nicht nur steuert, sondern Kunden im Workshop schon den Unterschied zwischen sauberem Datenmodell und teurer Migration zeigt.
2. Wir erfinden die PM-Rolle neu: In Zeiten von KI reicht bloßes Tickets-Schreiben nicht mehr – wir sind Innovationstreiber, keine Werkbank! Bei uns geht es um messbaren Impact, echtes Produktdenken und KI-Innovationen. Du steigst also in eine Rolle ein, die du aktiv mitgestalten kannst.
Aufgaben
Deine Mission
Projekte führen – von Anfang bis Betrieb. Du verantwortest Planung, Steuerung und Umsetzung großer E-Commerce-Projekte: Discovery, Konzept, Kickoff, Go-live und die Zeit danach. Technisch bewegen wir uns in Shopware, Adobe Commerce / Magento, commercetools, Pimcore und Storyblok.
Der Mensch sein, bei dem alles zusammenläuft. Du bist Hauptansprechpartner*in für unsere deutschsprachigen Kunden und die Brücke zu den Entwicklungsteams in Polen. Kundenbedürfnisse übersetzt du in saubere Lösungen, die Ideen des Teams bringst du zurück zum Kunden.
Impact – und zwar messbar. Messbar meinen wir wörtlich: Zu jeder Initiative gehören ein KPI und ein Tracking-Konzept, mit dem sich Vorher und Nachher belegen lassen.
Denken wie ein Product Owner. Behandle das Produkt wie dein eigenes! Wenn dich eine Funktion, ein Design oder eine Priorisierung nicht überzeugt, sprichst du es offen an. Bei unklarem Business Value stoppst du die Umsetzung, bis Klarheit herrscht. Die finale Entscheidung trifft der Kunde, klar – aber blind umgesetzt wird bei uns nichts.
Und der ganz normale Rest. Projektpläne, Timings, Budgets und Status-Reports hältst du zuverlässig auf Kurs. Meetings, Workshops, Sprint-Plannings und Retros moderierst du so, dass hinterher alle wissen, was Sache ist. Risiken erkennst du, bevor sie eins werden.
Deine Spezialisierung: PIM oder ERP
Hier liegt der Unterschied zu einer klassischen PM-Stelle. Eins von beidem bringst du mit:
PIM (Pimcore) – Du weißt, wie Produktdaten wirklich aussehen, bevor sie schön sind: Datenmodelle, Attribute, Varianten, Kanäle, Übersetzungen. Du hast schon mal eine Migration aus einer gewachsenen Excel-Landschaft begleitet und danach trotzdem noch an das Projekt geglaubt.
ERP (Odoo) – Bestände, Preise, Aufträge, Rechnungen, Schnittstellen. Du kannst einschätzen, was ins ERP gehört, was in den Shop und was besser in keins von beidem.
Beides mitzubringen wäre Angeberei – wir hätten aber nichts dagegen.
Du kommst aus einer vergleichbaren Welt, nur mit anderen Systemen (Akeneo, Contentserv, SAP, Business Central)? Dann sprich uns trotzdem an. Uns interessiert, ob du die Zusammenhänge verstehst, nicht welches Logo auf dem Login-Screen war.
Qualifikation
Du bist unser Mensch, wenn
Du mindestens 3 Jahre Projekte im digitalen Umfeld oder im E-Commerce geführt hast – von der ersten Idee bis in den Betrieb.
Du technisch mitreden kannst: APIs, PIM, ERP, Schnittstellen. Selbst programmieren musst du nicht. Verstehen, worüber die Devs gerade streiten, schon.
Scrum und Kanban dein Handwerkszeug sind und du Jira, Confluence und Miro im Schlaf bedienst.
Du fließend Deutsch (C2) und sehr gut Englisch sprichst – unsere Kunden sitzen im DACH-Raum, unsere Teams in Polen.
Du zwischen den Zeilen liest und Bedürfnisse erkennst, bevor sie im Briefing stehen.
Du aus einem leeren Blatt eine Roadmap machst: Backlog, Milestones, Budget, Timing.
Du KI-Tools schon im Alltag nutzt – oder große Lust hast, das in den nächsten Monaten zu ändern.

Situés au cœur de Lausanne, nous sommes une PME d'une cinquantaine de collaboratrices et collaborateurs passionné-e-s. Nous développons tipee, une application de gestion du temps et portail RH qui simplifie la vie de nos clients depuis plus de 10 ans.
Fonctionnant en mode participatif et agile, notre société est organisée en cercles où chacun-e est autonome, avec son mot à dire et des possibilités d'évolution au sein de la boîte. Et cela, avec un impact positif pour nos clients, nos collègues, la communauté et l'environnement.
Pour renforcer notre organisation, nous cherchons un-e **People & Culture Manager**. Ce poste de cadre te place au cœur de l'humain chez tipee : tu veilles à ce que chacun-e soit soutenu-e et accompagné-e au quotidien, tu fais vivre l'équité et la cohérence de nos pratiques RH, et tu contribues activement à notre culture d'entreprise et à notre marque employeur.
Ce poste combine deux rôles : à titre principal, celui de **People & Culture Manager**, et à titre secondaire, celui de **facilitateur-trice** au sein de nos cercles.
## Ton rôle au quotidien ##
Tu fais partie de la direction et tu travailles en lien étroit avec l'ensemble des cercles et des coordinateurs-trices.
* Tu es **à l'écoute des besoins** des collègues et des coordinateurs-trices, et tu es la personne de référence pour tout sujet touchant à l'humain au sein de tipee.
* Tu accompagnes les cercles dans leurs **recrutements** : tu ne recrutes pas à leur place, tu les outilles pour qu'ils sachent le faire eux-mêmes, et tu les appuies pour optimiser chaque processus.
* Tu conçois et fais vivre un **onboarding et un offboarding formalisés**, pour que chaque nouvel-le arrivant-e soit bien accueilli-e et chaque départ bien accompagné, quel que soit le cercle.
* Tu accompagnes l'évolution professionnelle des collaborateurs-trices : entretiens annuels en duo lorsque nécessaire, discussions avec les personnes concernées, et une réflexion continue sur les **parcours et la mobilité interne**.
* En collaboration avec les cadres, tu gères les **situations difficiles** (résolution de tensions, recadrage, conflit, etc.), avec la discrétion et l'écoute que ces moments demandent.
* Tu participes à la **diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion (DEIB)** au sein de tipee, et tu veilles à ce que nos pratiques soient inclusives à chaque étape du parcours collaborateur-trice.
* Tu clarifies et fais vivre **nos bonnes pratiques** : rédaction de guides, conventions et chartes en duo avec la direction, et contribution aux réflexions sur notre culture d'entreprise lors des séances cadres.
* Tu portes le rôle de **facilitateur-trice** : animation de rituels et stimulation de l'intelligence collective au sein de nos cercles.
* Tu participes à l'**organisation et à l'animation** de nos journées annuelles au vert.
* Tu t'assures que nos **cercles et rôles** suivent l'évolution de nos équipes.
* Tu **représentes tipee** à l'externe, lors de conférences ou salons RH, et tu partages ainsi notre vision de l'humain au travail.
* Tu favorises le **partage de connaissances** en interne et l'amélioration continue de nos pratiques, notamment via le suivi de notre questionnaire eNPS.
## Ce qu'on recherche ##
* Une expérience confirmée dans un rôle très orienté vers l'humain "- People & Culture, coaching, facilitation, Scrum Master, ou fonction similaire.
* Une posture de coach : tu préfères outiller et responsabiliser les équipes plutôt que de faire à leur place.
* Une réelle capacité d'écoute, d'empathie et de discrétion, notamment dans les situations sensibles.
* Un esprit d'initiative et l'envie de faire évoluer nos pratiques.
* Une aisance avec la culture produit, l'agilité et la facilitation (animation de rituels, intelligence collective, gestion des tensions).
* Le goût de représenter une entreprise à l'externe et de créer des partenariats.
* Une bonne compréhension du fonctionnement en cercles et en rôles, ou l'envie de t'y investir pleinement.
* De bonnes connaissances RH sont un plus, mais ne sont pas une condition.
Tu n'as pas besoin d'avoir un parcours RH classique pour réussir dans ce rôle : ce n'est pas un poste d'administration du personnel. Ce qui compte avant tout, c'est ta capacité à accompagner les gens, à faciliter, à créer de la confiance et être un soutien.
## Travailler chez tipee ##
* **Flexibilité** : horaires modulables, travail hybride (jusqu'à 50% à distance), taux d'activité adaptable à l'évolution de ta vie personnelle.
* **Locaux à Lausanne** : à 15 minutes à pied de la gare, ou 7 en vélo ou trottinette.
* **Formation** : un budget individuel pour des conférences ou formations sur les sujets qui t'intéressent.
* **Culture participative** : entraide, dialogue, confiance, prise de responsabilités.
* **Engagements** : certifiée B Corp et STI, engagée sur les aspects sociétaux et environnementaux.
* **Mobilité** : jusqu'à CHF 300.- par année pour tes frais de transport durable (abonnement CFF).
* **Conditions** : des prestations LPP attractives auprès d'une caisse durable, des avantages autour du congé parental, au moins 5 semaines de vacances, et plus.
* **Vie d'entreprise** : événements réguliers et moments conviviaux qui rythment l'année.
